sample_gumbel: sample from Gumbel(0,1) distribution given a tensor shape and optional epsilon
gumbel_softmax_sample: draw a sample from the Gumbel-Softmax distribution using log-probs and temperature
gumbel_softmax: sample from Gumbel-Softmax distribution and optionally discretize to one-hot vectors
create_gumbel_softmax_hard: create one-hot discrete samples from log-probs using gumbel_softmax with hard=True
test_gumbel_softmax_temperature: test gumbel_softmax behavior across different temperature values for soft and hard modes
